scope: Independent Reader B extraction only; no Reader A comparison and no topology construction.
procedure: Use only P02 overview/regions/tiles and P01/P02 metadata copied into isolated fpep_b workspace.
Rotate each P02 region/tile 90 degrees counter-clockwise for machine reading.
Run one Tesseract psm=11 English pass per tile/region; no iterative correction against expected values.
Reconstruct a 150 dpi page from P02 regions solely for additional decimal-text candidates.
Keep decimal strings as DIMENSION_TEXT_CANDIDATE; keep compact integer/alphabetic strings as raw text candidates.
Use RIF for OCR confidence >=85, INC for retained decimal candidates below 85; no OCR value is promoted to DOC.
Do not infer supports, members, coordinates, topology, target counts or section/reinforcement data.
limitations: Machine OCR is intentionally partial. Symbol classification and structural graphical-continuity semantics are not promoted by this method.
Any value that conflicts with Reader A remains unresolved until P04/P06; B values are never corrected by A.
